info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Events Ticketing Tickets Validates-v1-spec
info.description: The Ticket Validation API allows verification of event ticket authenticity to ensure a seamless entry experience for attendees. By checking the validity of tickets, event organizers can prevent fraud and enhance customer satisfaction. This API serves as an essential tool for ticketing platforms, event coordinators, and venue operators. Typically utilized during admissions and entry processes, it helps maintain the integrity of events by confirming ticket statuses in real-time.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to validate a ticket by checking its status and authenticity. It ensures that the ticket is legitimate and can be used for the designated access or service.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate ticket information. It ensures that the provided data for ticket validation is in the correct format and contains all necessary fields.

200.description: The ticket validation request was successful and the ticket is valid.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesReque.description: A string representation of the JSON request body for validating tickets in the operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the ticket validation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the operation associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The identifier of the result from the validation process.

state.description: The current state of the ticket validation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the validation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the validation result.

audit.description: Information about the audit of the ticket validation process.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesRespo.description: Response schema for the successful validation of a ticket.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or process that created the validation entry.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the validation entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the validation process was automated.

Audit.description: Audit information regarding the ticket validation process.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
